title: Workflow Agent Tools
description: Complete tool definitions for the Workflow Agent - Claude Code for Workflows

tools.name: getWorkflowGraph
tools.description: Retrieves the complete workflow structure including all nodes, edges, and their configurations. Use this to understand the current state of the workflow before making changes.

flowId.description: The unique identifier of the workflow to retrieve

includeExecutionState.description: Whether to include the current execution state of each node

tools.name: getNodeDetails
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific node, including its configuration, code (for JS nodes), HTTP settings (for HTTP nodes), and condition expressions (for condition/loop nodes).

nodeId.description: The unique identifier of the node to inspect

tools.name: getNodeTemplate
tools.description: Retrieves an MD template that provides guidance on how to implement a specific node pattern. Templates contain purpose, available APIs, input/output contracts, examples, and constraints.

templateName.description: The name of the template to retrieve (e.g., 'http-aggregator', 'data-transformer', 'api-poller')

tools.name: searchTemplates
tools.description: Searches for relevant MD templates based on a query. Returns a list of matching templates with their names and brief descriptions.

query.description: Search query to find relevant templates (e.g., 'fetch multiple APIs', 'transform JSON', 'retry logic')

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return

tools.name: getExecutionHistory
tools.description: Retrieves the history of workflow executions, including timestamps, duration, and overall success/failure status.

flowId.description: The workflow to get execution history for

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return

tools.name: getExecutionLogs
tools.description: Retrieves detailed logs from a specific workflow execution, including per-node inputs, outputs, errors, and timing information.

executionId.description: The execution ID to get logs for

nodeId.description: Optional: filter logs to a specific node

tools.name: createJsNode
tools.description: Creates a new JavaScript node in the workflow. JS nodes execute custom JavaScript code and have access to fetch, workflow SDK (variables, secrets), and logging APIs.

flowId.description: The workflow to add the node to

code.description: JavaScript code to execute. Should export an async function: async function execute(input) { ... return output; }

tools.name: createHttpNode
tools.description: Creates a new HTTP request node in the workflow. HTTP nodes make HTTP requests with configurable method, URL, headers, query parameters, and body.

flowId.description: The workflow to add the node to

httpId.description: ID of an existing HTTP request configuration to link to this node

deltaHttpId.description: Optional: ID of a delta/override HTTP configuration

tools.name: createConditionNode
tools.description: Creates a conditional (if/else) branch node. The condition expression determines which path (THEN or ELSE) the workflow follows.

flowId.description: The workflow to add the node to

tools.name: createForNode
tools.description: Creates a for-loop node that iterates a fixed number of times.

flowId.description: The workflow to add the node to

condition.description: Optional: condition expression to check before each iteration (early exit)

errorHandling.description: How to handle errors: IGNORE continues, BREAK stops the loop

tools.name: createForEachNode
tools.description: Creates a forEach loop node that iterates over an array from the input data.

flowId.description: The workflow to add the node to

iteratorPath.description: JSONPath-like expression to the array to iterate (e.g., 'input.data.items', 'input.users')

condition.description: Optional: condition expression to check before each iteration

errorHandling.description: How to handle errors: IGNORE continues, BREAK stops the loop

tools.name: updateNodeCode
tools.description: Updates the JavaScript code of an existing JS node.

nodeId.description: The ID of the JS node to update

tools.name: updateNodeConfig
tools.description: Updates the configuration of an existing node (name, position, condition expression, loop settings, etc.).

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to update

condition.description: For condition/loop nodes: updated condition expression

iterations.description: For for-loop nodes: updated iteration count

iteratorPath.description: For forEach nodes: updated iterator path

errorHandling.description: For loop nodes: updated error handling

tools.name: connectNodes
tools.description: Creates an edge (connection) between two nodes in the workflow.

sourceNodeId.description: The ID of the source node (where the edge starts)

targetNodeId.description: The ID of the target node (where the edge ends)

sourceHandle.description: Which output handle to connect from. THEN is the default/success path, ELSE is for condition false branch, LOOP is for loop iteration connections.

tools.name: disconnectNodes
tools.description: Removes an edge (connection) between two nodes.

edgeId.description: The ID of the edge to remove

tools.name: deleteNode
tools.description: Removes a node from the workflow. This also removes all edges connected to this node.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to delete

tools.name: createVariable
tools.description: Creates a new workflow variable that can be accessed by all nodes in the workflow.

flowId.description: The workflow to add the variable to

description.description: Description of what this variable is used for

tools.name: updateVariable
tools.description: Updates an existing workflow variable.

variableId.description: The ID of the variable to update

tools.name: deleteVariable
tools.description: Deletes a workflow variable.

variableId.description: The ID of the variable to delete

tools.name: runWorkflow
tools.description: Executes the workflow. Creates a snapshot version and runs all nodes in sequence based on the graph topology.

tools.name: stopWorkflow
tools.description: Stops a currently running workflow execution.

tools.name: validateWorkflow
tools.description: Validates the workflow structure, checking for issues like disconnected nodes, missing configurations, circular dependencies, and other potential problems.
